messages:
maya: Heads-up — ran the first A/B run for the v3->v3q-lite rollout on staging. smallbatch: 10k requests, mix of longdoc + chat.
aj: Nice — quick summary? any red flags?
maya: Latency looks fine (p50 ~ 92ms, p95 ~ 340ms). Quality delta: slight decrease in rerank MRR on longform slices (~1.8% relative).
sam: 1.8% MRR drop on longform is nontrivial. Which slices are driving it?
maya: Mostly 'legal-qa' and 'technical-specs' stratified slices. These have long context and many numeric tokens.
li: Did we enable hybrid KV warmup for the quantized variant? That usually helps long-context fidelity.
maya: Yes — KV warmup on. I suspect tokenization rounding from int4 quant is nudging numerical tokens.
nora: Any hallucination uptick? precision / factuality metrics?
maya: No major hallucination lift in our automated checks (QA-F1 delta ~ +0.2%). But concordance score with reference summaries down ~1.1%.
aj: Given those signals, what's the proposed gate decision? keep testing, rollback, or partial slice holdback?
maya: Proposal: enact a multistage gate — promote to 10% traffic but hold back the top 3 longdoc-heavy slices (legal-qa, tech-specs, financial-reports). Run 48h weighted A/B on remaining traffic, then re-evaluate.
sam: Sounds reasonable. We should also add an automatic fallback threshold: if longdoc rerank MRR degrades >1.5% on any watch slice for 1h, flip traffic back to v3.
li: Agreed. Add a soft hysteresis to avoid noisy flips: require degradation to persist across 3 consecutive 20-min buckets.
maya: I'll draft the rollout policy. Quick config snippet:
```
rollout_policy:
  baseline: v3
  variant: v3q-lite
  initial_traffic: 0.10
  holdback_slices:
    - legal-qa
    - technical-specs
    - financial-reports
  fallback_rules:
    - metric: longdoc_rerank_mrr
      delta_threshold: -0.015
      window: 3600  # seconds
      buckets: 3
      action: immediate-fallback
```
aj: Can we also shadow 5% of holdback_slices to v3q-lite to gather telemetry without impacting users?
maya: Yes — shadowing on for those slices. We'll collect per-token alignment, exact-match on numeric spans, and kv-hit rate.
nora: Make sure to enable alerts in console: 3-min paging for p95 latency > 1s on variant, and pager for fallback rule trip.
deploy-bot: rollout started: v3q-lite -> 10% (holdback slices applied). monitoring link: https://console.redwood/s/rollouts/1765432102
sam: Thanks. I'll keep an eye on the A/B dashboard and post back hourly summaries.
li: I'll add a quick eval harness to run synthetic numeric-precision tests every 30m.
maya: Initial 2h snapshot will be in ~120m. If anyone sees surprising diffs post that, @aj @li ping me and we'll pause the rollout. :thumbsup:
aj: ack
li: ack
nora: ack
